title: I think I might be trapped in an area of Mall World
content: I don't know how else to explain this, but for the past week or so I have been unable to explore different areas of Mall world. I have been trapped in what seems like this safe house or retreat house. It's like really high-end. But all of the walls are made from like brick or cement like you might find in Florida or California. But it's like a high-end classy Mansion school. Looking thing. There's gates and some people have cars. But it's like I can't travel outside of this specific base or something. Like I can go outside the gate and there's designated fun areas, but I can no longer access the larger state of Mall World for some reason.
